# lroolle-design-skill

> One agent skill for designing any user-facing surface with taste
> built in: sense the brief, derive grounded directions and let dice
> assign one (challengers dealt from a deck of born-designed graphic
> systems), write the chosen world into the artifact as a five-block
> promise, build with full commitment against a token contract, and
> review the render against the promise in a fresh context. Seven
> material languages sharing one token schema; a worlds deck with a
> CJK half; a craft layer loaded by need; surface recipes; runnable
> bans. MIT. Private pre-release.

Install: clone into your agent's skill root (e.g.
`~/.claude/skills/lroolle-design`) or `npx skills@latest add
lroolle/lroolle-design-skill` once public. No build step; `bans.sh`
and `validate.sh` are bash + grep.

## Entry

- [SKILL.md](SKILL.md): the protocol -- gate, laws, six phases (sense,
  direct, contract, build, review, deliver), the modes, the first-sense table
  by territory, the check, the repository map

## Decks and dice

- [worlds/README.md](worlds/README.md): what a world is, tiers, ratings, the deal; one card per `worlds/<id>.md`
- [stagings/README.md](stagings/README.md): compositions for surface-scope rolls; `stagings/<id>.md`
- [scripts/roll.mjs](scripts/roll.mjs): `node scripts/roll.mjs --scope direction|surface --mode <mode> [--grain] [--key] [--reroll n] [--json]`

## Design systems (material contracts; same token names, swap the css file)

- [design-systems/README.md](design-systems/README.md): the table, the
  12-section contract schema, the token contract and its invariants
- [default](design-systems/default.md) · [modernist](design-systems/modernist.md) ·
  [classical](design-systems/classical.md) · [industry](design-systems/industry.md) ·
  [organic](design-systems/organic.md) · [nocturnes](design-systems/nocturnes.md) ·
  [broadsheets](design-systems/broadsheets.md) · [_template](design-systems/_template.md)
- tokens: `assets/tokens/<system>.css` (light + dark, OKLCH);
  [assets/specimen.html](assets/specimen.html) renders any of them
